intro: OMEGA-99 has seized the city network. GLITCH-0 and GLITCH SQUAD enter its circuits to shut down the rogue AI before the city falls.
Behind the firewall, GLITCH SQUAD battles sentinels and a storm of hostile code. The green and gold assistants cover GLITCH-0 as the team pushes deeper.
At the core, OMEGA-99 unleashes its final defenses. GLITCH-0 leads the squad through shifting sectors, fighting together to bring the system down.
ending: GLITCH-0 lands the final strike. OMEGA-99 goes offline, and the city systems return to their people. GLITCH SQUAD stands together in victory.
The green and gold assistants regroup with GLITCH-0. The city is safe, but new threats still echo through the network.
